s.d: ἀνα-φωνέω, -ῶ [in LXX for שָׁמַע hi., זָכַר hi. ;] to cry out, exclaim: [[luke 1 42|Luk.1:42]] (Arist., al.).† (AS)
ἀνά-χυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναχέω, to pour out), a pouring out, overflowing, excess: metaphorically, [[1-peter 4 4|1Pe.4:4]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνα-χωρέω, -ῶ [in LXX for בָּרַח, נוּם, etc. ;] 1. to go back. 2. to withdraw: [[matthew 9 24|Mat.9:24;]] frequently in sense of avoiding danger (MM, VGT, see word), [[matthew 2 12|Mat.2:12]] (but see Thayer), [[matthew 2 13|Mat.2:13-14, 22 4:12 12:15 14:13 15:21 27:5]], [[mark 3 7|Mrk.3:7]], [[john 6 15|Jhn.6:15]], [[acts 23 19|Act.23:19 26:31]].† (AS)
ἀνά-ψυξις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναψύχω), [in LXX: [[exodus 8 15|Exo.8:15]] (רְוָחָה)* ;] a refreshing: [[acts 3 19|Act.3:19.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-ψύχω [in LXX for נָפַשׁ ni., חָיָה, etc. (frequently in sense of revive, refresh oneself) ;] to refresh: with accusative of person(s), [[2-timothy 1 16|2Ti.1:16]] (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 588).† (AS)
ἀνδραποδιστής, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀνδράποδον, a slave, captured in war) a slave-dealer, kidnapper: [[1-timothy 1 10|1Ti.1:10]] (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνδρίζω [in LXX for חָזַק אָמַץ ([[joshua 1 6|Jos.1:6]] ff., [[1-chronicles 22 19|1Ch.22:19]], al.; in [[2-kings 10 12|2Ki.10:12]], [[psalms 27 14|Psa.27:14 31:24]] combined with κρατιοῦσθαι, as in 1Co, l.with) ;] to make a man of. Mid., to play the man (cf. MM, VGT, see word): [[1-corinthians 16 13|1Co.16:13.]]† (AS)
Ἀνδρόνικος, -ου, ὁ Andronicus: [[romans 16 7|Rom.16:7.]]† (AS)
ἀνδρο-φόνος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: 2Ma.9:28 * ;] a man-slayer: [[1-timothy 1 9|1Ti.1:9]] (cf. φονεύς, and see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀν-έγκλητος, -ον (ἀ-, ἐγκαλέω), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:31 * ;] not to be called to account, unreprovable: [[1-corinthians 1 8|1Co.1:8]], [[colossians 1 22|Col.1:22]], [[1-timothy 3 10|1Ti.3:10]], [[titus 1 6|Tit.1:6-7]].† SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ἀνεπίλημπτος (see Tr., Syn., § ciii; Cremer, 742; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
ἀν-εκδιήγητος, -ον (ἀ-, ἐκδιηγέομαι) inexpressible: [[2-corinthians 9 15|2Co.9:15]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀν-εκ-λάλητος, -ον (ἀ-, ἐκλαλέω), unspeakable: [[1-peter 1 8|1Pe.1:8.]]† (AS)
ἀνέκλειπτος, -ον (ἀ-, ἐκλείπω), unfailing: [[luke 12 33|Luk.12:33]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
αν-εκτός, -όν (also in late Gk. -ή, -όν; ἀνέχομαι), tolerable: compar., -ότερος, [[matthew 10 15|Mat.10:15 11:22, 24]], [[luke 10 12|Luk.10:12, 14]] † (AS)
ἀν-ελεήμων, -ον (-ἀ, ἐλεήμων), [in LXX for אַכְזָר ;] without mercy: [[romans 1 13|Rom.1:13.]]† (AS)
ἀνεμίζω = Attic ἀνεμόω (ἄνεμος); pass., to be driven by the wind: [[james 1 6|Jas.1:6.]]† (AS)

ἄνεμος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for רוּחַ ;] wind: [[matthew 11 7|Mat.11:7 14:24, 30 14:32]], [[mark 4 37|Mrk.4:37, 39 4:41 6:48, 51]], [[luke 7 24|Luk.7:24 8:23-24]], [[john 6 13|Jhn.6:13]], [[acts 27 7|Act.27:7, 14-15]], [[james 3 4|Jas.3:4]], [[revelation 6 13|Rev.6:13 7:1]]; pl., [[matthew 7 25|Mat.7:25, 27 8:26-27]], [[luke 8 25|Luk.8:25]], [[acts 27 4|Act.27:4]], Ju 12; οἱ τέσσαρες ἄ. τῆς γῆς, [[revelation 7 1|Rev.7:1;]] hence the four quarters of the heavens (see Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, see word), [[matthew 24 31|Mat.24:31]], [[mark 13 27|Mrk.13:27]]; metaphorically, of variable teaching, Eph 414.† SYN.: πνεῦμα, πνοή (and cf. θύελλα, λαῖλαψ). (AS)
ἀν-ένδεκτος, -ον (ἀ- neg., ἔνδεκτος; ἐνδέχομαι), impossible, inadmissible: [[luke 17 1|Luk.17:1.]]† (AS)
ἀνεξεραύνητος (Rec. -εύνητος, as in Attic; M, Pr., 46), -ον (ερευνάω), [in Sm. (-ευ-): Pr., 25:3 * ;] unsearchable: [[romans 11 33|Rom.11:33.]]† (AS)
ἀνεξί-κακος, -ον (fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός) patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, Wis.2:19; and see MM, VGT, see word): [[2-timothy 2 24|2Ti.2:24.]]† (AS)

ἀνεξιχνίαστος, -ον (ἀ- neg., ἐξιχνιάζω, to track out; ἴχνος) [in LXX: [[job 5 9|Job.5:9 9:10 34:24]] (חֵקֶר אַיִן)* ;] that cannot be traced out: [[romans 11 33|Rom.11:33]], [[ephesians 3 8|Eph.3:8]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀν-επ-αίσχυντος, -ον (ἐπαισχύνομαι) not to be put to shame: [[2-timothy 2 15|2Ti.2:15.]]† (AS)

ἀν-επί-λημπτος (Rec. -λμπτος; Bl., § 6, 8), -ον (ἀ- ἐπιλαμβάνω) without reproach: [[1-timothy 3 2|1Ti.3:2 5:7 6:14]].† SYN.: ἀμεμπτος, ἀνέγκλητος. It is stronger than these, for it implies not only that the man is of good report, but that he is deservedly so (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

ἀν-έρχομαι [in LXX: [[1-kings 13 12|3Ki.13:12]] (הָלַךְ)* ;] to go up: [[john 6 3|Jhn.6:3]], [[galatians 1 17|Gal.1:17-18]] (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up " to the capital, MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἄνεσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀνίημι), [in LXX: 2Es.4.22 (שָׁלוּ), [[2-chronicles 23 15|2Ch.23:15]], I [[esther 4 62|Est.4:62]], Wis.13:13, Sir.15:20 26:10 * ;] a loosening, relaxation: [[acts 24 23|Act.24:23]] (RV, indulgence; cf. MM, VGT, see word); by St. Paul, opposite to θλίψις, expressed or understood, relief: [[2-corinthians 2 12|2Co.2:12 7:5 8:13]], [[2-thessalonians 1 7|2Th.1:7]].† SYN.: ἀνάπαυσις (which see).† (AS)

ἀν-ετάζω (ἀνά, ἐτάζω, to examine; see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: [[judges 6 29|Jdg.6:29]] (דָּרַשׁ), [[esther 2 23|Est.2:23]] (בָּקַשׁ), Da TH Su 1:14 * ;] to examine judicially: [[acts 22 24|Act.22:24, 29]]..† (AS)
ἄνευ prep. with genitive (rarer than χωρίς, which see; cf. Ellic. on [[ephesians 2 12|Eph.2:12;]] MM, VGT, 42), without: [[matthew 10 29|Mat.10:29]], [[1-peter 3 1|1Pe.3:1 4:9]].† (AS)
ἀν-εύ-θετος, -ον (see MM, VGT, see word) not well placed, not fit: [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12.]]† (AS)
ἀν-ευρίσκω (ἀνά, εὑρίσκω), [in LXX: 4Ma.3:14 * ;] to find out by search, discover (see Field, Notes, 47 f.): [[luke 2 16|Luk.2:16]], [[acts 21 4|Act.21:4]].† (AS)

ἀν-έχω [in LXX chiefly for אָפַק hithp. ;] to hold up; in NT always mid., to bear with, endure: in cl. most frequently with accusative, but in NT with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 17 17|Mat.17:17]], [[mark 9 19|Mrk.9:19]], [[luke 9 41|Luk.9:41]], [[2-corinthians 11 1|2Co.11:1 11:19]], [[ephesians 4 2|Eph.4:2]], [[colossians 3 13|Col.3:13]]; before μικρόν τι, with genitive of person(s) and with genitive of thing(s), [[2-corinthians 11 1|2Co.11:1;]] with dative of thing(s), [[2-thessalonians 1 4|2Th.1:4]] (v M, Th., in l); before εἴ τις, [[2-corinthians 11 20|2Co.11:20;]] absol., [[1-corinthians 4 12|1Co.4:12]], [[2-corinthians 11 4|2Co.11:4]]; to bear with = to listen to, with genitive of person(s), [[acts 18 14|Act.18:14;]] with genitive of thing(s), [[2-timothy 4 3|2Ti.4:3]], [[hebrews 13 22|Heb.13:22]] (cf. προσανέχω and MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνεψιός, -οῦ, ὁ (cf. Lat. nepos), [in LXX: [[numbers 36 11|Num.36:11]] ( בֵּן דּוֹד), Tob.7:2 9:6 א * ;] a cousin: [[colossians 4 10|Col.4:10]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
anise, dill , (Aristophanes Comicus); ionic ἄννησον or ἄνησον (Herdotus Historicus); aeolic ἄννητον, or ἄνητον, (Sapho). (ML)

ἀν-ήκω (ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: [[joshua 23 14|Jos.23:14]] (בּוֹא), [[1-samuel 27 8|1Ki.27:8]], Sir. prol.10, 1, 2 Mac6* ;] prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, it is befitting: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, see word), [[ephesians 5 4|Eph.5:4]], [[colossians 3 18|Col.3:18]]; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.† (AS)
ἀν-ήμερος, -ον (ἀ-, ἥμερο ), not tame, savage (MM, VGT, see word): [[2-timothy 3 3|2Ti.3:3.]]† (AS)

ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;] a man, Lat. vir. 1. As opposite to a woman, [[acts 8 12|Act.8:12]], [[1-timothy 2 12|1Ti.2:12]]; as a husband, [[matthew 1 16|Mat.1:16]], [[john 4 16|Jhn.4:16]], [[romans 7 2|Rom.7:2]], [[titus 1 6|Tit.1:6]]. 2. As opposite to a boy or infant, [[1-corinthians 13 11|1Co.13:11]], [[ephesians 4 13|Eph.4:13]], [[james 3 2|Jas.3:2]]. 3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, [[luke 5 8|Luk.5:8;]] ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, [[acts 1 16|Act.1:16;]] and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, [[acts 22 3|Act.22:3;]] ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35. 4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, [[luke 8 41|Luk.8:41]], [[acts 6 11|Act.6:11]]. SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;] a man, Lat. vir. 1. As opposite to a woman, [[acts 8 12|Act.8:12]], [[1-timothy 2 12|1Ti.2:12]]; as a husband, [[matthew 1 16|Mat.1:16]], [[john 4 16|Jhn.4:16]], [[romans 7 2|Rom.7:2]], [[titus 1 6|Tit.1:6]]. 2. As opposite to a boy or infant, [[1-corinthians 13 11|1Co.13:11]], [[ephesians 4 13|Eph.4:13]], [[james 3 2|Jas.3:2]]. 3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, [[luke 5 8|Luk.5:8;]] ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, [[acts 1 16|Act.1:16;]] and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, [[acts 22 3|Act.22:3;]] ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35. 4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, [[luke 8 41|Luk.8:41]], [[acts 6 11|Act.6:11]]. SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

ἀνθ-ίοτημι (ἀντί, ἵστημι), [in LXX for עָמַד, יָצַב, etc. ;] 1. in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, to set against. 2. In mid, and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., to withstand, resist, oppose: with dative, [[matthew 5 39|Mat.5:39]], [[luke 21 15|Luk.21:15]], [[acts 6 10|Act.6:10 13:8]], [[romans 9 19|Rom.9:19 13:2]], [[galatians 2 11|Gal.2:11]], [[ephesians 6 13|Eph.6:13]], [[2-timothy 3 8|2Ti.3:8 4:15]], [[james 4 7|Jas.4:7]], [[1-peter 5 9|1Pe.5:9]].† (AS)

ἀνθ-ομολογέομαι, -οῦμαι (ἀντί, ὁμολογέομαι) [in LXX: [[psalms 79 13|Psa.79:13]] (יָדָה), Dan LXX 4:34 (שְׁבַח), I [[esther 8 91|Est.8:91]], Sir.20:2, 3Ma.6:33 * ;] 1. to make a mutual agreement (Dem., Polyb.). 2. to acknowledge fully, confess (Diod., Polyb., cf. 1Esdras, l.with). 3. C. dative of person(s), to declare one's praises, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, give thanks to (cf. Ps, l.with): [[luke 2 38|Luk.2:38]] (Cremer, 771; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἄνθος, -εος, τό [in LXX for צִיץ, etc. ;] a flower: [[james 1 10|Jas.1:10-11.]] [[1-peter 1 24|1Pe.1:24]]" (LXX) .† (AS)
ἀνθρακιά, -ᾶς, ἡ (ἄνθραξ), [in LXX: Sir.11:32, 4Ma.9:20 * ;] a heap of burning coals: [[john 18 18|Jhn.18:18 21:9]].† (AS)
ἄνθραξ, -ακος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for גֶּחֶל ;] coal, charcoal: . ἄ. πυρός, a burning coal, [[romans 12 20|Rom.12:20.]]† (AS)

ἀνθρωπ-άρεσκος, -ον (ἄνθρωπος, ἄρεσκος, pleasing), [in LXX: [[psalms 53 5|Psa.53:5]] * ;] studying to please men: [[ephesians 6 6|Eph.6:6]], [[colossians 3 22|Col.3:22]] (Cremer, 642; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνθρώπινος, -η, ον (ἄνθρωπος), [in LXX for אָדָם, אֱנוֹשׁ ;] human, belonging to man: χεῖρες, [[acts 17 25|Act.17:25;]] σοφία, [[1-corinthians 2 13|1Co.2:13;]] φύσις, [[james 3 7|Jas.3:7;]] κτίσις, [[1-peter 2 13|1Pe.2:13]] (MM, VGT, see word); ἀ. ἡμέρα, opposite to ἡ ἡμ. ([[1-corinthians 3 13|1Co.3:13]], God's Judgment-Day), human judgment, [[1-corinthians 4 3|1Co.4:3]] (see Lft., Notes, 198); πειρασμὸς ἀ., temptation such as man can bear (AV, such as is common to man, see Field, Notes, 175), [[1-corinthians 10 13|1Co.10:13;]] ἀνθρώπινον λέγω, I speak in human fashion, with words not properly weighed, [[romans 6 19|Rom.6:19]] (see Field, Notes, 156).† (AS)
ἀνθρωποκτόνος, -ον (κτείνω, to kill) a murderer, manslayer (Eur.; see MM, VGT, see word): [[john 8 44|Jhn.8:44]], [[1-john 3 16|1Jn.3:16]].† SYN.: φονεύς, ἀνδροφόνος (see Tr., Syn, § 83) (AS)

ἄνθρωπος, -ου, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ ,אָדָם, also for אֱנוֹשׁ, etc. ;] man: 1. generically, a human being, male or female (Lat. homo): [[john 16 21|Jhn.16:21;]] with art., [[matthew 4 4|Mat.4:4 12:35]], [[mark 2 27|Mrk.2:27]], [[john 2 25|Jhn.2:25]], [[romans 7 1|Rom.7:1]], al; disting. from God, [[matthew 19 6|Mat.19:6]], [[john 10 33|Jhn.10:33]], [[colossians 3 23|Col.3:23]], al.; from animals, etc., [[matthew 4 19|Mat.4:19]], [[luke 5 10|Luk.5:10]], [[revelation 9 4|Rev.9:4]], al.; implying human frailty and imperfection, [[1-corinthians 3 4|1Co.3:4;]] σοφία ἀνθρώπων, [[1-corinthians 2 5|1Co.2:5;]] ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαι, [[1-peter 4 2|1Pe.4:2;]] κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖν, [[1-corinthians 3 3|1Co.3:3;]] κατὰ ἄ. λέγειν (λαλεῖν), [[romans 3 5|Rom.3:5]], [[1-corinthians 9 8|1Co.9:8]]; κατὰ ἄ- λέγειν, [[galatians 3 15|Gal.3:15]] (cf. [[1-corinthians 15 32|1Co.15:32]], [[galatians 1 11|Gal.1:11]]); by meton., of man's nature or condition, ὁ ἔσω (ἔξω) ἄ., [[romans 7 22|Rom.7:22]], [[ephesians 3 16|Eph.3:16]], [[2-corinthians 4 16|2Co.4:16]] (cf. [[1-peter 3 4|1Pe.3:4]]); ὁ παλαιὸς, καινὸς, νέος ἄ., [[romans 6 6|Rom.6:6]], [[ephesians 2 15|Eph.2:15 4:22, 24]] [[colossians 3 9|Col.3:9, 10]]; joined with another subst., ἄ. ἔμπορος, a merchant, [[matthew 13 45|Mat.13:45]] (WH, txt. om. ἄ.); οἰκοδεσπότης, [[matthew 13 52|Mat.13:52;]] βασιλεύς, 18:23; φάγος, 11:19; with name of nation, Κυρηναῖος, [[matthew 27 32|Mat.27:32;]] Ἰουδαῖος, [[acts 21 39|Act.21:39;]] Ῥωμαῖος, [[acts 16 37|Act.16:37;]] pl. οἱ ἄ., men, people: [[matthew 5 13|Mat.5:13, 16]] [[mark 8 24|Mrk.8:24]], [[john 4 28|Jhn.4:28]]; οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων, [[mark 11 2|Mrk.11:2]], [[1-timothy 6 16|1Ti.6:16]]. 2. Indef., ἄ. = τις, some one, a man: [[matthew 17 14|Mat.17:14]], [[mark 12 1|Mrk.12:1]], al.; τις ἄ., [[matthew 18 12|Mat.18:12]], [[john 5 5|Jhn.5:5]], al.; indef. one (Fr. on), [[romans 3 28|Rom.3:28]], [[galatians 2 16|Gal.2:16]], al.; opposite to women, servants, etc., [[matthew 10 36|Mat.10:36 19:10]], [[john 7 22|Jhn.7:22]], 23. 3. Definitely, with art., of some particular person; [[matthew 12 13|Mat.12:13]], [[mark 3 5|Mrk.3:5]], al.; οὗτος ὁ ἄ., [[luke 14 30|Luk.14:30;]] ὁ ἄ οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος, [[mark 14 71|Mrk.14:71]], [[matthew 12 45|Mat.12:45]]; ὁ ἄ. τ. ἀνομίας, [[2-thessalonians 2 3|2Th.2:3;]] ἄ τ. θεοῦ (of Heb. אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים), [[1-timothy 6 11|1Ti.6:11]], [[2-timothy 3 17|2Ti.3:17]], [[2-peter 1 21|2Pe.1:21]]; ὁ υἰὸς τοῦ ἀ., see: υἱός. SYN.: ἀνήρ, which see (and cf. MM, VGT, 44; Cremer, 103, 635). (AS)
ἀνθ-υπατεύω (see next word), to be proconsul: [[acts 18 12|Act.18:12]] Rec. (see: ἀνθύπατος).† (AS)

ἀνθύπατος -ου, ὁ (ἀντί, ὕπατος, altern. for ὑπέρτατος), supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province (cf. ἡγεμών, and see MM, VGT, 44): [[acts 13 7|Act.13:7-8, 12 18:12 19:38]].† (AS)

ἀν-ίημι (ἀνά, ἵημι), [in LXX for רָפָה, נָשָׂא, etc. ;] 1. to send up, produce, to send back. 2. to let go, leave without support: [[hebrews 13 5|Heb.13:5]] (cf. [[deuteronomy 31 6|Deu.31:6;]] Hom., Iliad., ii, 71). 3. to relax, loosen (see Field, Notes, 124 f.): [[acts 16 26|Act.16:26 27:40]]; hence, metaphorically, to give up, desist from: [[ephesians 6 9|Eph.6:9.]]† (AS)
ἀν-έλεος, -ον (Attic ἀνηλεής, ἀνελεήμων; MM, VGT, see word), merciless: [[james 2 13|Jas.2:13.]]† (AS)
ἄνιπτος, -ον (ἀ. neg., νίπτω), unwashed: [[matthew 15 20|Mat.15:20]], [[mark 7 5|Mrk.7:5]] (5 Rec).† (AS)

ἀνίστημι (ἀνά, ἵστημι), [in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;] 1. causal, in fut. and 1 aor. act., with accusative, to raise up: [[acts 9 41|Act.9:41;]] from death, [[john 6 39|Jhn.6:39]], [[acts 2 32|Act.2:32]]; to raise up, cause to be born or appear: [[matthew 22 24|Mat.22:24]], [[acts 3 22|Act.3:22, 26]]. 2. Intrans., in mid. and 2 aor act.; (a) to rise: from lying, [[mark 1 35|Mrk.1:35;]] from sitting, [[luke 4 16|Luk.4:16;]] to leave a place, [[matthew 9 9|Mat.9:9;]] pleonastically, as Heb. קוּם, before verbs of going, [[mark 10 1|Mrk.10:1]], al. (see Dalman, Words, 23; M, Pr., 14); of the dead, [[matthew 17 23|Mat.17:23]], [[mark 8 31|Mrk.8:31]]; before ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[matthew 17 9|Mat.17:9]], [[mark 9 9|Mrk.9:9]]; (b) to arise, appear: [[acts 5 36|Act.5:36]], [[romans 15 12|Rom.15:12]] (cf. ἐπ-, ἐξ- ἀνίστημι, and see Cremer, 306, 738; MM, VGT, see word). SYN.: ἐγείρω. (AS)
Ἄννα, -ας, ἡ (Heb. חָנָה), Anna, a prophetess: [[luke 2 36|Luk.2:36.]]† (AS)
Ἄννας, -α (FlJ, Ἄνανος, -ου), ὁ (Heb. חָנַן), Annas, the high priest: [[luke 3 2|Luk.3:2]], [[john 18 13|Jhn.18:13-24]], [[acts 4 6|Act.4:6]].† (AS)

ἀ-νόητος, -ον (ἀ- neg., νοητός; νοέω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 17 28|Pro.17:28]] (אֱוִיל), Sir.42:8, al. ;] 1. not thought on, not understood (Hom., Plat.). 2. not understanding, foolish (Hdt., al., LXX): [[luke 24 25|Luk.24:25]], [[romans 1 14|Rom.1:14]], [[galatians 3 1|Gal.3:1]], 3, [[1-timothy 6 9|1Ti.6:9]], [[titus 3 3|Tit.3:3]] (Cremer, 438, 790; MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: ἀσύνετος (see Tr., Syn., § LXXv) (AS)

ἀνοια, -ας, ἡ (ἄ-νοος, without understanding), [in LXX: [[proverbs 14 8|Pro.14:8, 2215]] (אִוֶּלֶת), Wis.15:18, al. ;] folly, foolishness: [[2-timothy 3 9|2Ti.3:9;]] expressed in violent rage (cf. Plat., Tim., 86B): [[luke 6 11|Luk.6:11.]]† (AS)

ἀν-οίγω (ἀνά, οἴγω = οἴγνυμι) [in LXX chiefly for פָּתַח ;] to open; 1. trans., with accusative; a door or gate, [[acts 5 19|Act.5:19 12:14]], [[revelation 4 1|Rev.4:1]]; pass., [[acts 12 10|Act.12:10 16:26-27]]; metaphorically of opportunity or welcome, [[acts 14 27|Act.14:27]], [[colossians 4 3|Col.4:3]], [[revelation 3 20|Rev.3:20]]; pass., [[1-corinthians 16 9|1Co.16:9]], [[2-corinthians 2 12|2Co.2:12]], [[revelation 3 8|Rev.3:8]]; absol. (sc. θύραν), [[acts 5 23|Act.5:23 12:16]]; with dative of person(s), [[luke 12 36|Luk.12:36]], [[john 10 3|Jhn.10:3]]; metaphorically, [[matthew 7 7|Mat.7:7-8 25:11]], [[luke 11 9|Luk.11:9-10 13:25]], [[revelation 3 7|Rev.3:7]]; θησαυρούς (Sir.43:14), [[matthew 2 11|Mat.2:11]]; τ. μνημεῖα, [[matthew 27 52|Mat.27:52;]] τάφος, [[romans 3 13|Rom.3:13;]] τ. φρέαρ, [[revelation 9 2|Rev.9:2;]] of heaven, [[matthew 3 16|Mat.3:16]], [[luke 3 21|Luk.3:21]], [[acts 10 11|Act.10:11]], [[revelation 11 19|Rev.11:19 15:5 19:11]]; σφραγῖδα, [[revelation 5 9|Rev.5:9 6:1]] ff. [[revelation 8 1|Rev.8:1]]; βιβλίον, βιβλαρίδιον, [[luke 4 17|Luk.4:17]], [[revelation 5 2|Rev.5:2-5 10:2, 8 20:12]]; τ. στόμα, [[matthew 17 27|Mat.17:27;]] id. Hebraistically ([[numbers 22 28|Num.22:28]], [[job 3 1|Job.3:1]], [[isaiah 50 5|Isa.50:5]], al.), of beginning to speak, [[matthew 5 2|Mat.5:2]], [[acts 8 32|Act.8:32, 35 10:34 18:14]]; before εἰς βλαιφημίας, [[revelation 13 6|Rev.13:6;]] ἐν παραβολαῖς ([[psalms 78 2|Psa.78:2]]), [[matthew 13 35|Mat.13:35]]; of recovering speech, [[luke 1 64|Luk.1:64;]] of the earth opening, [[revelation 12 16|Rev.12:16;]] τ. ὀφθαλμoύς, [[acts 9 8|Act.9:8, 40]]; id. with genitive of person(s), of restoring sight, [[matthew 9 30|Mat.9:30 20:33]], Jhn.9:1ff; 10.21, 11:37ff ; metaphorically, [[acts 26 18|Act.26:18;]] ἀκοάς, with genitive of person(s), of restoring hearing, [[mark 7 35|Mrk.7:35.]] 2. Intrans. in 2 pf., ἀνέῳγα (M, Pr., 154); heaven, [[john 1 51|Jhn.1:51;]] τ. στόμα, before πρός, of speaking freely, [[2-corinthians 6 11|2Co.6:11]] (cf. δι-ανοίγω and see MM, VGT, 45).† (AS)
ἀν-οικο-δομέω, -ῶ [in LXX for בָּנָה, גָּדַר ;] to build. again, rebuild (MM, VGT, see word): [[acts 15 16|Act.15:16.]]† (AS)
ἄνοιξις, -εως, ἡ (ἀνοίγω), an opening (in MGr., springtime): ἐν ἀ., as often as I open, [[ephesians 6 19|Eph.6:19.]]† (AS)

ἀνομία, -ας, ἡ (ἄνομος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, פֶּשַׁע, תּוֹעֵבַה, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;] lawlessness, iniquity: [[matthew 7 23|Mat.7:23 13:41 23:28 24:12]], [[romans 6 19|Rom.6:19]], [[2-corinthians 6 14|2Co.6:14]], [[2-thessalonians 2 3|2Th.2:3 2:7]], [[titus 2 14|Tit.2:14]], [[hebrews 1 9|Heb.1:9]], [[1-john 3 4|1Jn.3:4]]; in pl. (as LXX, [[psalms 31 1|Psa.31:1]], al.; see 131., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), of acts or manifestations of lawlessness: [[romans 4 7|Rom.4:7]] (LXX), [[hebrews 10 17|Heb.10:17.]]† SYN.: see: ἁμάρτημα, ἄνομος (AS)

ἄ-νομος, -ον (ἀ. neg., νόμος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;] 1. lawless, wicked: [[mark 15 28|Mrk.15:28]], [[luke 22 37|Luk.22:37]], [[acts 2 23|Act.2:23]], [[1-timothy 1 9|1Ti.1:9]], [[2-peter 2 8|2Pe.2:8]]; ὁ ἄ., [[2-thessalonians 2 8|2Th.2:8]] (= ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας, [[2-thessalonians 2 3|2Th.2:3]]). 2. without law (= οἱ μὴ ὑπὸ νόμον, [[romans 2 14|Rom.2:14]]): [[1-corinthians 9 21|1Co.9:21]] (MM, VGT, see word). † SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος (AS)
ἀνόμως, adv. [in LXX: 2Mac 817* ;] 1. lawlessly (2Mac, l.with). 2. = χωρὶς νόμου, without law: [[romans 2 12|Rom.2:12.]]† (AS)

ἀν-ορθόω, -ῶ (ἀνά, ὀρθόω, to set straight, set up), [in LXX chiefly for כּוּן hi. ;] to set upright or straight again, restore: of persons, [[luke 13 13|Luk.13:13]], [[hebrews 12 12|Heb.12:12]]; of things, σκηνήν, [[acts 15 16|Act.15:16]] (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 807).† (AS)

ἀν-όσιος, -ον (ἀ- neg., ὅσιος), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 22 9|Eze.22:9]] (זִמָּה, Wis.12:4, 2Ma.7:34 2Mac 8:32, 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 5:7, 4Ma.12:11 * ;] unholy, profane (Cremer, 464): [[1-timothy 1 9|1Ti.1:9]], [[2-timothy 3 2|2Ti.3:2]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνοχή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀνέχω, -ομαι), [in LXX: 1Ma.12:25 (RV, respite)* ;] 1. in cl., a holding back, delaying (MM, VGT, see word). 2. forbearance, delay of punishment: [[romans 2 4|Rom.2:4 3:26]].† SYN.: μακροθυμία, ὑπομονή. ἀ., forbearance, is the result and expression of μ., which involves the idea of tolerance, long-suffering, as God with sinners. ὑ. expresses patience with respect to things, as μ. with persons; it is active as well as passive, denotes not merely endurance but perseverance (see Tr., Syn., § liii; Lft., Notes, 259, 273; DB, ii, 47). (AS)
ἀντ-αγωνίζομαι depon., [in LXX: 4Ma.17:14 * ;] to struggle against: before πρός, with accusative, [[hebrews 12 4|Heb.12:4.]]† (AS)

ἀντ-άλλαγμα, -τος, τό (ἀντί, ἄλλαγμα; ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מְחִיר ;] an exchange, the price received as an equivalent for an article of commerce: [[matthew 16 26|Mat.16:26]], [[mark 8 37|Mrk.8:37]] (cf. Sir.26:14; and see Swete, Mk., l.with; Cremer, 90).† (AS)
ἀντ-ανα-πληρόω, -ῶ (ἀντί, ἀναπληρόω), to fill up in turn: [[colossians 1 24|Col.1:24]] (see Lft., in l; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀντ-απο-δίδωμι (ἀντί ἀποδίδωμι), [in LXX for שָׁלַם pi., גָּמַל, שׁוּב hi., etc. ;] to give back as an equivalent, recompense, requital (the ἀντί ex­pressing the idea of full, complete return; see Lft., Notes, 46); (a) in favourable sense: [[luke 14 14|Luk.14:14]], [[romans 11 35|Rom.11:35]], [[1-thessalonians 3 9|1Th.3:9]]; (b) in unfavourable sense: [[romans 12 19|Rom.12:19]], [[2-thessalonians 1 6|2Th.1:6]], [[hebrews 10 30|Heb.10:30]].† (AS)

ἀντ-από-δομα, -τος, τό (ἀνταποδίδωμι) [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל ;] ( = cl. -δοσις, which see) requital; (a) in favourable sense: [[luke 14 12|Luk.14:12;]] (b) in unfavourable sense: [[romans 11 9|Rom.11:9.]]† (AS)
ἀντ-από-δοσις, -εως, ἡ (see supr.), [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל, שִׁלּוּם ;] recompense: [[colossians 3 24|Col.3:24]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀντ-απο-κρίνομαι (ἀντί, ἀποκρίνω), [in LXX: [[judges 5 29|Jdg.5:29]], [[job 16 9|Job.16:9]] (8) [[job 32 12|Job.32:12]] (עָנָה)* ;] to answer again, reply against: before πρός, with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 14 6|Luk.14:6;]] with dative of person(s), [[romans 9 20|Rom.9:20.]]† (AS)
ἀντ-εῖπον (άντί, εἶτον), [in LXX for H7725 hi., דָבַר pi., עָנָה, etc. ;] 2 2 aor., without present in use, to speak against, gainsay: [[luke 21 15|Luk.21:15]], [[acts 4 14|Act.4:14]].† (AS)

ἀντ-ὲχω (ἀντί, ἔχω), [in LXX for חָזַק hi., etc. ;] 1. trans., to hold against. 2. Intrans., to withstand. Mid. 1. in cl., to hold out against. 3. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), to hold firmly to, cleave to: with genitive (see Bl., § 36, 2), [[matthew 6 24|Mat.6:24]], [[luke 16 13|Luk.16:13]], [[1-thessalonians 5 14|1Th.5:14]] (see M, Th., in l), [[titus 1 9|Tit.1:9.]]† (AS)

ἀντί (the ι is elided only in ἀνθ᾽ ὧν), prep. with genitive (cf. MM, VGT, see word); 1. prop, in local sense, over against, opposite, hence 2. instead of, in place of, for (Hom., etc.): [[matthew 5 38|Mat.5:38 17:27]], [[luke 11 11|Luk.11:11]], [[1-corinthians 11 15|1Co.11:15]], [[hebrews 12 2|Heb.12:2]]; with artic. inf. (cl.), [[james 4 15|Jas.4:15;]] of succession, [[matthew 2 22|Mat.2:22;]] χάριν ἀ. χάριτος, [[john 1 16|Jhn.1:16]] (M, Pr., 100); of price in exchange, [[hebrews 12 16|Heb.12:16;]] λύτρον ἀ. πολλῶν, [[matthew 20 28|Mat.20:28]], [[mark 10 45|Mrk.10:45]] (M, Pr., 105); of requital, [[romans 12 17|Rom.12:17]], [[1-thessalonians 5 16|1Th.5:16]], [[1-peter 3 9|1Pe.3:9]] (cf. Wis.11:15); ἀνθ᾽ ὧν, because, [[luke 1 20|Luk.1:20 19:44]], [[acts 12 23|Act.12:23]], [[2-thessalonians 2 10|2Th.2:10]] (cl., LXX for אֲשֶׁר תַּחַת); id. therefore (cl., LXX), [[luke 12 3|Luk.12:3;]] ἀ. τούτου (LXX for כֵּן נַעֲרָה)[[ephesians 5 31|Eph.5:31.]] As a prefix, ἀντι- (before vowels ἀντ-, ἀνθ᾽-), denotes (a) over against, ἀντιπέραν; (b) co-operation, ἀντιβάλλειν; (with) requital, ἀντιμισθία; (d) opposition, ἀντίχριστος; (e) substitution, ἀνθύπατος. Compounds of ἀ. usually govern dative (B1., § 37, 7).† (AS)
ἀντι-βάλλω [in LXX: 2Ma.11:13 * ;] to throw in turn, exchange: metaphorically, λόγους (cf. Lat. conferre sermons; see Field, Notes, 81), [[luke 24 17|Luk.24:17.]]† (AS)
ἀντι-δια-τίθημι in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose: [[2-timothy 2 25|2Ti.2:25]] (EV; but see Field, Notes, 215 f.; cf. MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

ἀντίδικος, -ον (δίκη), [in LXX for רִיב ;] as subst., an opponent in a lawsuit, adversary: [[matthew 5 25|Mat.5:25]], [[luke 12 58|Luk.12:58 18:3]], [[1-peter 5 8|1Pe.5:8]] (Cremer, 696; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀντί-θεσις, -εως, ή (τίθημι), opposition: [[1-timothy 6 20|1Ti.6:20.]]† (AS)

ἀντι-καθ-ίστημι [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 31 21|Deu.31:21]] (עָנָה), [[joshua 5 7|Jos.5:7]], [[micah 2 8|Mic.2:8]] (קוּם) * ;] 1. causal in Pres. imperfect fut. and 1 aor.; to replace, oppose. 2. Intrans. in pass. and 2 aor. act.; (a) to supersede; (b) to resist: [[hebrews 12 4|Heb.12:4.]]† (AS)
to invite in turn , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

ἀντί-κειμαι [in LXX for אָיַב, צוּר, שָׂטַן, etc. ;] 1. to lie opposite to. 2. to oppose, withstand, resist: with dative, [[luke 13 17|Luk.13:17 21:15]], [[galatians 5 17|Gal.5:17]], [[1-timothy 1 10|1Ti.1:10]]; as participial subst. (ὁ) ἀντικείμενος, [[1-corinthians 16 9|1Co.16:9]], [[philippians 1 28|Php.1:28]], [[2-thessalonians 2 4|2Th.2:4]], [[1-timothy 5 14|1Ti.5:14]] (Cremer, 746).† (AS)

ἄντικρυς (Tr. -ύς, Rec. ἀντικρύ), adv. (ἀντί) [in LXX: [[nehemiah 12 8|Neh.12:8]] (נֶגֶד), 3Ma.5:16 * ;] in cl., outright; in κοινή (= cl. καταντικρύ), over against: [[acts 20 15|Act.20:15]] (see Bl., § 5, 4; 40, 7; Rutherford, NPhr., 500 f.; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀντι-λαμβάνω [frequently in LXX for חָזַק hi., סָמַךְ, etc ;] to take instead of or in turn. Mid., with genitive, to take hold of; (a) of persons, to help (see MM, VGT, see word): [[luke 1 54|Luk.1:54]], [[acts 20 35|Act.20:35]]; (b) of things, to partake of: [[1-timothy 6 2|1Ti.6:2]] (see Field, Notes, 210; Cremer, 386; and cf. συν-αντιλαμβάνω).† (AS)

ἀντι-λέγω [in LXX: [[hosea 4 4|Hos.4:4]] (רִיב hi.), [[isaiah 50 5|Isa.50:5]] (סוּג ni.) [[isaiah 22 22|Isa.22:22 65:2]], Sir.4:25, 3Ma.2:28, 4Ma.4:7 4Mac 8:2 * ;] cοntradict, oppose, resist (see Field, Notes, 106; MM, VGT, see word); absol.: [[acts 28 19|Act.28:19]], [[romans 10 21|Rom.10:21]], [[titus 1 9|Tit.1:9 2:9]]; with dative, [[john 19 12|Jhn.19:12]], [[acts 13 45|Act.13:45]]; with accusative and inf., [[luke 20 27|Luk.20:27]] T; pass., [[luke 2 34|Luk.2:34]], [[acts 28 22|Act.28:22]].† (AS)

ἀντί-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις; see MM, VGT see word; M, Pr., 56), -εως, ἡ (ἀντιλαμβάνομαι) [in LXX for עֹז, זְרוֹעַ, etc., frequently in [[psalms 2 1|Psa.2:1-12]],3Mac.; frequently also in π. in petitions to the Ptolemies in sense of βοήθεια (see Deiss., LAE, 107; BS, 92, 223) ;] 1. cl. a laying hold of, an exchange. 2. Hellenistic (LXX, π.) help: pl. of ministrations of deacons; [[1-corinthians 12 28|1Co.12:28]] (DB, ii, 347 f.; Cremer, 386).† (AS)

ἀντιλογία, -ας ἡ (ἀντιλέγω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;] gain-saying, strife (the latter sense being found in π.; see MM, VGT, see word; cf. Field, Notes, 106): [[hebrews 6 16|Heb.6:16 7:7 12:3]], Ju 11.† (AS)
to rail at or abuse in turn , (New Testament); Mid., with accusative rei, (Lucian) (ML)
ἀντί-λυτρον, -ου, τό [in Al.: [[psalms 49 9|Psa.49:9]] * ;] a ransom: [[1-timothy 2 6|1Ti.2:6]] (see CGT, in l; and cf. λύτρον).† (AS)
ἀντι-μετρέω, -ῶ to measure in return: [[luke 6 38|Luk.6:38]] (WH, mg., μετρέω).† (AS)
ἀντιμισθία, -ας, ἡ (ἀντίμισθος, for a reward) a reward, requital: in good sense, [[2-corinthians 6 13|2Co.6:13;]] in bad sense, [[romans 1 27|Rom.1:27]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
Ἀντιοχεύς, -έως, ὁ a citizen of Antioch, an Antiochian: [[acts 6 5|Act.6:5.]]† (AS)
ἀντι-παρ-έρχομαι [in LXX: Wis.16:10 * ;] to pass by opposite to: [[luke 10 31|Luk.10:31-32]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
Ἀντίπας (T, Ἀντείπας), -α (in some MSS. it appears to be indecl.; but see M, [[proverbs 12 1|Pro.12:1-28;]] it is abbrev. from Ἀντίπατρος), ὁ, Antipas: [[revelation 2 13|Rev.2:13.]]† (AS)
Ἀντιπατρίς, -ίδος, ἡ Antipatris, bet. Joppa and Caesarea: [[acts 23 31|Act.23:31.]]† (AS)
ἀντί-περα (Rec. ἀντιπέραν, LTr. ἀντιπέρα) adv., = cl. ἀντιπέρας (MM, VGT, 49), on the opposite side: with genitive, [[luke 8 26|Luk.8:26.]]† (AS)

ἀντι-πίπτω [in LXX: [[exodus 26 5|Exo.26:5]] (קָבַל), [[exodus 26 17|Exo.26:17]] (שׁוּב), [[numbers 27 14|Num.27:14]] (מְרִיבָה) [[job 23 13|Job.23:13]] (שָׁלַב hi.) * ;] 1. to fall against or upon (Arist., Polyb.). 2. to strive against, resist (Arist.): with dative, [[acts 7 51|Act.7:51]] (AS)
ἀντι-στρατεύομαι to make war against: with dative, [[romans 7 23|Rom.7:23.]]† (AS)

ἀντι-τάσσω (Att..., -ττω) [in LXX for לוּץ hi., נָשָׂא, etc. ;] to range on battle against; mid., to set oneself against, resist: absol., [[acts 18 6|Act.18:6;]] with dative, [[romans 13 2|Rom.13:2]], [[james 4 6|Jas.4:6 5:6]], [[1-peter 5 5|1Pe.5:5]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀντί-τυπος, -ον (see: τύπος), [in LXX: [[esther 3 13|Est.3:13]] A * ;] 1. active striking back; metaphorically, resisting, adverse. 2. Pass. struck back; metaphorically, corres­ponding to (MM, VGT, see word); (a) as impression of a seal or copy of an archetype (τύπος) (RV, Like in pattern), [[hebrews 9 24|Heb.9:24;]] (b) as the reality (of which τύπος is the copy or adumbration) (RV, after a true likeness), [[1-peter 3 21|1Pe.3:21]] (Cramer, 357).† (AS)
